##### Project general facts

Anbar Residences, developed by Eagle Hills, is located within the prestigious Maryam Island in Sharjah, offering studios and 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. The project reflects a contemporary architectural style that blends clean lines with functional elegance, creating a refined waterfront residential environment. Thoughtfully designed layouts and premium detailing enhance the sense of comfort and modern urban living in a prime island setting.

The development offers a wide selection of lifestyle amenities designed to support relaxation, wellness, and community living. Residents have access to state-of-the-art fitness centers, temperature-controlled swimming pools, children’s play areas, barbecue zones, and beautifully landscaped gardens. In addition, the project benefits from 24/7 security and direct beach access, allowing residents to enjoy a serene coastal lifestyle with open views of the Arabian Gulf.

The interiors are finished with high-quality premium materials, ensuring a refined and durable living environment. The kitchens are fully equipped with appliances, combining practicality with modern design. The units are delivered unfurnished, giving residents the freedom to style and personalize their homes according to their own preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Maryam Island is located in downtown Sharjah overlooking the Arabian Sea. It provides easy access to Sharjah and the neighbouring Emirates of Dubai, Ajman, and Umm Al Quwain via the Al Taawun and Al Ittihad Roads.  

Set to take the tourism industry of Sharjah by storm, Maryam Island promises to be the ultimate leisure and lifestyle destination with a range of alluring amenities and unique gastronomical offerings.  

Combined with the utmost privacy, the serene residential spaces offer visitors, tenants, owners, and guests the experience of a lifetime, with a relaxing promenade and a wealth of upscale amenities.
